name: Fishing Journal and Trophies
description: The journal, records, Fishy Notes, the Trophy Mount and the satchel.

pages.title: Fishing Journal and Trophies
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- The **Fishing Journal** fills a page for each new fish you catch.
- It keeps your **longest, shortest and heaviest** of each fish.
- **Fishy Notes** show a fish's page before you catch it.
- Show catches on a **Trophy Mount**.

Lost the journal? Craft one from any fish and a book. It also works on a lectern.\
\
Uncaught fish are black outlines. A page shows where and when the fish bites (biome, depth, time, weather, moon, season, temperature), then how many you've caught, when, and your records.

Catches made by your [#](2E5AAC)[rod machines](entry://fishing/rod_machines)[#]() count as yours.\
\
Fill half the journal for **Aquatic Archivist**, all of it for **A Reel Completionist**. Own every rod blank and special rod for **Hooked on Variety**. Your best weight of each species also shows on the Keep or Release screen.

pages.title: Fishy Note
pages.text: Every crate holds one, usually for a fish you haven't found. Or craft any fish with paper. Right-click to see that fish's page.

pages.title: Trophy Mount
pages.text: Sticks around a log. Hang it on a wall and right-click with a fish to mount it, shown at its real size with its weight, length and who caught it. An empty hand takes it back.

pages.title: Fish Satchel
pages.text: 4 leather around a fish. Right-click to open it; while open, fish you pick up go straight in. Holds 64 fish.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Aquaculture's fish mounts still work for its fish: six buttons around a Medium Hook make one. Fish under 3 kg stack by species and size class; bigger fish and trophies keep their own numbers and don't stack.\
\
Fish swimming in the world can be caught in a water bucket as usual (lava fish need a lava bucket).
